title: create_work answer
description: The memory tool create_work's answer (migration 079): a new memory saved as a work item of its project, or a memory that was here already made one. A write's shape with work, the item's properties: no memory's words, a project by id and slug only. For a new item revision is 1, changed is empty, replayed says an earlier call with the same idempotency key did this, due is its deadline when the call gave one (never for a held memory), and duplicates names the memories of its scope it was flagged as a possible copy of. For a memory made one (id) changed is ["work"], the state before is kept as a version, history records it (work_changed) and undo makes it an ordinary memory again; a repeat with the same properties answers unchanged true. Refused (invalid): no project, the tag task (a personal task is no work item), a decision or a standing instruction, a state done or cancelled, a memory that is a work item already with other properties, and content together with id; held and retracted for a memory held for review or marked wrong; conflict for a stale expected_revision; key_reused. Listed and answered only with memory.tools and memory.work on, and refused (off) with the second off (contracts/README.md 2.1). The JSON in its text content, and on success the same as its structured content; a refusal is isError true with the refusal body.
